review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Verified five empirical densities from logs at 1e6 and 1e9..1e12
Recomputed 5-point OLS fit, R², and residuals
Checked log SHA prefixes against sha256sum

claim_reviews.evidence: Exact match to density_A12_1000000.log and gpu_A12_1e9..1e12.log (1e12: 84.5791333633%, uncovered 154208666367).
Early rows track the older 3-point fit (~30.1+4.65 log10 N); the 1e12 row tracks the 5-point fit. The table mixes models.
Frontmatter/summary correctly mark predictions beyond 1e12 as extrapolations; largest residual is at the newest point (-0.53%), a healthy warning against overconfidence.

claim_reviews.claim: BK exponent 0.062 governs R(d) asymptotics, not a proved density speedup.
claim_reviews.evidence: Post-remediation framing correctly separates representation-count asymptotics from unique-denominator density.

claim_reviews.claim: 1e13/1e14 bitset allocations OOM on available hardware.
claim_reviews.evidence: gpu_A12_1e13.log / 1e14.log: FATAL cudaMalloc bitset out of memory.

missing_references: Single-model residual table; optional chunked >1e12 methodology if extrapolation remains central
overall_assessment: A careful empirical convergence study with five hashed GPU points, honest OOM limits, and correct separation of R(d) theory from density. The mixed 3-pt/5-pt residual table is the main internal inconsistency; the 1e15 forecast is already properly hedged.
recommendations: Rebuild the residual table from a single fit
Do not upgrade certification based on extrapolation quality
certification_justification: Solid computational observation with literature-grounded δ({1,2}), but the log-density law is empirical/novel without a proved density theorem — bronze.
